summary: Ubisoft's Shaun White-branded action-sports games, spanning open-mountain snowboarding, Wii Balance Board-focused snowboarding, an iOS origin spin-off, and a stylized skateboarding entry.

entries.title: Shaun White Snowboarding
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360 Target Limited Edition with Mile-High Pack DLC where owned; Wii Road Trip as secondary

emulation.emulator: Xbox 360 hardware/Xenia for HD route; Dolphin for Wii Road Trip
emulation.notes: Prefer owned Xbox 360 content for completeness and Wii hardware/Dolphin for the Road Trip version. DLC preservation depends on prior ownership.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox 360 complete-content route for sourced completeness; PC may be higher native fidelity but is not the sourced complete route

primary.version: Target Limited Edition with Mile-High Pack DLC where owned
primary.why: Shaun White Snowboarding released across Nintendo DS, PSP, Wii, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, PlayStation 2, Windows, and Mac OS X. There is Target Limited Edition content and the Mile-High Pack DLC, while the Wii version is a distinct Road Trip version with Balance Board focus. Xbox 360 with owned Target/DLC content is the most complete route; Windows may be a higher native-fidelity route but lacks the same complete-content case.
primary.how_to_play: Use an Xbox 360 copy with the Target Limited Edition content and the Mile-High Pack DLC already owned/installed where possible; play Wii Road Trip separately if preserving the motion-control/Balance Board version.

secondary.why: The Wii version carries a distinct subtitle, supports the Wii Balance Board, and was publicly singled out as the strongest-reviewed/most distinct version.
secondary.how_to_play: Play on Wii or Wii U with the Wii Remote/Nunchuk and optional Wii Balance Board.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; Target Limited Edition and Mile-High Pack DLC availability are ownership/access dependent on legacy platforms.

emulation.notes: Use original Wii hardware or Dolphin; motion/Balance Board peripherals may affect authenticity.

primary.why: Shaun White Snowboarding: World Stage is a Wii-exclusive sequel to Shaun White Snowboarding, with Wii Balance Board and Wii MotionPlus support noted in public series summaries. Wii is the only released platform and therefore the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii or Wii U with Wii Remote/Nunchuk and optional Wii Balance Board/MotionPlus support.

entries.title: Shaun White Snowboarding: Origins

emulation.notes: Use original compatible iOS hardware or an already-preserved app install; general-purpose emulation is not a reliable route.

primary.why: Shaun White Snowboarding: Origins is publicly listed as an iOS snowboarding game released in December 2009. iOS is the only sourced release platform and therefore the complete route, though modern access may be limited.
primary.how_to_play: Use a compatible legacy iOS device or preserved owned app install if available; modern App Store access should not be assumed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or modern rerelease; mobile preservation depends on legacy iOS compatibility and ownership.

entries.title: Shaun White Skateboarding

emulation.notes: Run the Windows release natively on compatible hardware; use RPCS3/Xenia/Dolphin only for platform comparisons.

primary.why: Shaun White Skateboarding released for Windows, PlayStation 3, Wii, and Xbox 360 in 2010 as a spin-off of the Shaun White Snowboarding duology. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible route for the city-shaping skateboarding entry.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC version on compatible hardware at the highest stable settings; use PS3/Xbox 360/Wii as console alternatives.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; PS3/Xbox 360 versions use an in-game digital manual instead of a paper manual.
